description: Paid ($0.25 USDC). A signed Ed25519 receipt binding your SHA-256 digest (or text) and optional claim to a settled payment. The receipt signature checks offline; the receipt chain is not externally anchored.

claim.description: Optional short statement to include in the receipt.

payment_signature.description: Optional. An x402 v2 payment you signed for this call's quote (the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header value). Omit to get the price quote first.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 digest to bind. Give sha256 or text.

text.description: Text to hash and bind, if you don't have a digest.

name: genesis402_prove

also_accepted_networks.description: Other payment networks this endpoint accepts.

how_to_pay.description: How to pay for this call.

mode.description: QUOTE_ONLY when no payment was made; the quote is in price.

paid.description: true or the paid quote when payment settled.

payment_required_b64.description: The raw x402 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header, base64.

price.description: Quote on Base USDC: atomic, usd, payTo, network.

resource.description: The endpoint URL that was quoted or called.

settlement.description: Decoded x402 settlement (tx hash, network, payer).

title: Signed proof receipt
